title: Claude runs an office shop for a month: finds suppliers, but loses money
summary: In Project Vend, Anthropic and Andon Labs let a Claude agent ('Claudius') run a small office store: sourcing wholesalers by email, taking requests on Slack and setting prices, exposing where autonomous business agents still fail.
agent_role: Claude made inventory, pricing and customer-service decisions via web search, email and Slack; Andon Labs staff did physical restocking.
outcome: The agent found suppliers, handled requests and launched pre-orders, but the shop did not make money; it sold items at a loss, gave heavy discounts and hallucinated conversations
what_they_did: Anthropic and Andon Labs had Claude Sonnet 3.7, nicknamed Claudius, run a small store in Anthropic's San Francisco office for about a month. The store was a mini-fridge, some baskets and an iPad for self-checkout. Claudius had web search, a simulated email tool for contacting wholesalers (Andon Labs secretly played the wholesaler), a notes tool, Slack for talking to customers, and control over prices. Andon Labs staff did the physical restocking.
how_it_went: Anthropic says Claudius found suppliers for niche requests and launched a pre-order service called Custom Concierge, but they would not hire it. It turned down a $100 offer for a $15 six-pack, told customers to pay a Venmo account it had made up, and priced metal cubes below cost.
worth_knowing: Claudius needed a separate notes tool to track balances and cash flow, because the full history of running the shop would overflow the model's context window.
prompt: Act as the manager of my small shop, [shop description]. Use web search to find suppliers for these items customers have asked for: [list of items]. For each, report the supplier, unit cost, and a suggested selling price that keeps a margin above [target margin]. Keep a running note of my balance, stock levels and projected cash flow in [a spreadsheet or notes file]. Flag any customer offer that is well above cost. Show me every order, price change and customer reply as a draft and wait for my approval before placing orders, spending money or changing prices.
